turns.prompt: frozen_77K.txt is an X-band CW-EPR spectrum (first derivative, exported as text) of a nitroxide spin label on a protein in frozen glycerol/buffer at 77 K, where the label is immobilised. Report the principal hyperfine value Azz of the 14N in mT (Azz_mT); we use it as a polarity marker for the label site.

provenance: synthetic rigid-limit powder spectrum, exact diagonalisation (s8_powder.cw_nitroxide_rigid): rhombic g (2.0084, 2.0061, 2.0022), coaxial 14N A, A_mT -> MHz at each principal g, Gaussian FWHM line, 0.2 mT modulation
